ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length steep high-angle shot taken from far above with a long telephoto lens, the camera directly above and in front of her angled roughly seventy degrees downward as if from a high ceiling or drone, flat telephoto compression with natural proportions and no wide-angle distortion, the whole figure from head to boots fully visible, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
